entries.07820a33d6745dde: Processing and Sales (Kyodo Suisan and Kitashoku)
entries.1df0ce93a56506e3: This business provides cold storage of seafood and related services. Toichi Logistics Co., Ltd. leases the company’s Toyosu and Toyomi cold storage facilities and conducts cold storage operations, and Tsukiji Kigyo Co., Ltd. handles cargo handling inside those cold storage facilities. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,466 million.
entries.1fdded76552c8de0: A company that, as a consignee at the Tokyo Metropolitan Central Wholesale Market (Toyosu Market), focuses on wholesaling marine products and also operates a cold storage warehouse business and a real estate leasing business.
